events.body: Evaluate direct push remotes or an authenticated SSH-tunnel fanout so a local source-of-truth desktop node behind a firewall can update mirror2 and mirror3 immediately after a push. Keep this in the security backlog until the design covers least-privilege deploy keys per repository/node, host-key pinning, no shared user credentials, forced commands, branch/ref authorization, replay resistance, auditable delivery receipts, retry/backpressure behavior, key rotation/revocation, and integrity-pin verification against the source attestation. Do not enable automatic tunnel access until a threat model and rollback plan are reviewed. The public organization identity must remain forkmesh; mirror2 and mirror3 are nodes, not users.
events.title: Secure instant source-to-mirror push over SSH tunnels
